property_summary: Once C has been Initialized(), SetMinSum is permanently locked: every subsequent call to SetMinSum must revert and never change MinSum; the mutant drops the guard so a post-initialization SetMinSum succeeds and mutates MinSum.

After calling SetMinSum(v) before initialization, the public getter c.MinSum() must equal v for any admissible v; the mutant stores v+1 and violates this for every input.
For any value v, calling SetMinSum(v) while uninitialized must store exactly v in MinSum (c.MinSum() == v); the mutant always stores 0, so any v != 0 breaks this rule.
